body:
added branch with maven with name "maven"
Steps to reproduce:
1. checkout https://github.com/Shohou/quarkus_bug/tree/maven
2. `./mvnw quarkus:dev` and see it works
3. `./mvnw package`, `docker build --tag test -f ./docker/Dockerfile .`, `docker run -it --rm test` and get the same exception

So this bug is not gradle related

issue.body:
**Describe the bug**
I create an ApplicationScoped class twice through a separate Dependent config. It works in dev mode, but fails in production

**Expected behavior**
Either fail in dev mode or work everywhere

**Actual behavior**

**To Reproduce**
1. checkout https://github.com/Shohou/quarkus_bug
2. run `./gradlew clean quarkusDev` and see that `someClass2\n someClass1` message is printed
3. run `./gradlew clean build`, then `docker build --tag test -f ./docker/Dockerfile .` and `docker run -it --rm test` and see the exception
